# Moons & Stars

**Moons & Stars** is a simple Unity game with procedural plantes made by me as a graduation project. Some things were added to it later on and it is a somewhat incomplete project at the moment. 
## Technical Features
* Procedurally made planets based on cube-spheres with variable terrain features generated by Perlin-noise
* Custom shaders that colors each region of the planet based on its height
* A quadtree based level of detail system that sections the planet into multiple quadrants recursively or merges these quadrants back together based on the distance to the camera
* Some simple state machine based AI creatures that can chase the player and shoot at it

  Feel free to use any part of this project
